rows: Supplementary Figure S8E; p53–THOC4-N, 8 ligand equivalents

sqrt(delta_H_ppm^2 + (delta_N_ppm/7)^2); each 8-equivalent spectrum is compared with the reference at the same NaCl concentration.
Mask CSP <= 0.001 ppm; retain peaks above this cutoff at either salt. Sort by 150 mM CSP. Statistics use all matched peaks, without masking.
No independent replicate uncertainty supplied. Peaks within a spectrum are correlated observations; no peak-level significance test is reported.
Salt-dependent CSP attenuation supports a salt-sensitive response; it does not quantify Kd or prove a uniquely electrostatic mechanism.
